tiers.name: Empty
uniques: [-2 Happiness] [in all cities] <when number of [floor([Gold] / [Cities])] is less than [25]>

tiers.name: Low
uniques: [-1 Happiness] [in all cities] <when number of [floor([Gold] / [Cities])] is between [25] and [49]>

tiers.name: Stocked
uniques: [+1 Happiness] [in all cities] <when number of [floor([Gold] / [Cities])] is between [75] and [99]>

tiers.name: Abundant
uniques: [+2 Happiness] [in all cities] <when number of [floor([Gold] / [Cities])] is between [100] and [149]>
[+10]% Production [in all cities] <when number of [floor([Gold] / [Cities])] is between [100] and [149]>

tiers.name: Full
uniques: [+2 Happiness] [in all cities] <when number of [floor([Gold] / [Cities])] is between [150] and [249]>
[+25]% Production [in all cities] <when number of [floor([Gold] / [Cities])] is between [150] and [249]>

tiers.name: Overflowing
uniques: [+3 Happiness] [in all cities] <when number of [floor([Gold] / [Cities])] is more than [249]>
[+40]% Production [in all cities] <when number of [floor([Gold] / [Cities])] is more than [249]>

limitations: Seven physical stage buildings now exist and swap at Khazad turn start and when founding a city; Gold spent or gained during a turn does not instantly replace the visible building.
Android gameplay verification of the new building swapping, city Happiness/Production attribution, save/reload, and conquest is outstanding.
Seven stage icons are original generated replacements, not original EMM DDS artwork.
notes: This JSON captures authoritative pinned EMM threshold/source values; its tiers[].uniques array records the previously proven conditional nation-level formula for reference, not effects still present on Khazad Nation. The current mod places exact source effects on seven city buildings and uses 38 complementary <upon turn start> / <upon founding a city> remove/grant uniques. See docs/khazad-vaults.md.
